Michigan, Births and Christenings, 1775-1995 (collection 1675348). Broader collection covering civil registrations AND church christenings. Searched surname Mogan/Magan, father John, birth years 1865-1910. 90 total (hasMore), 20 returned. Key findings in first page: (1) Martin Magin, born 24 Sep 1887, Detroit, Wayne County, father John Magan — third confirmation of the already-extracted birth (also in collections 1459684 and 1923472); (2) a record titled 'Entry for John Magan' at ark:/61903/1:2:MRKD-PCL with Mary Magan as mother (batch C03196-8) — likely John V Mogan's birth appearing in this broader collection, already in tree as I4; (3) Winerford Magan (born 2 Oct 1873, Troy, Oakland county) and Mathew Magan (born 16 Jul 1875, Troy, Newaygo county) — different John Magan family from Oakland/Newaygo counties, NOT Wayne/Detroit; (4) John Migan, Cornelius Migan, Oscar Migan family (Detroit, father John Migan) — the recurring German-origin Migan family. No additional unknown children of John and Mary Mogan found beyond Martin Magin already documented.

Michigan Deaths 1867-1897 (collection 1452402), targeted search for Martin Magin/Mogan born 1886-1889. 1 result: 'Migan' (no given name), male, born 1888, died 21 August 1888, Detroit, Wayne — this is the recurring German-origin Migan family (seen throughout the county births searches), not Martin Magin. Confidence 1, score -4.6 (very low). No death record for Martin Magin/Magan/Mogan born 24 Sep 1887 found in the Michigan statewide death collection covering 1867-1897. His death likely went unregistered or occurred under a spelling variant not captured, or he survived past 1897 but died before the June 1900 census was taken.

Michigan Deaths and Burials 1800-1995 (collection 1675357), targeted search for Martin Magin/Mogan born 1886-1889. 1 result: same unrelated 'Migan' male, born 1888, died 21 August 1888, Detroit, Wayne (batch B59943-1) — same German-origin Migan family. No death record for Martin Magin found in the broader burial collection either. Martin Magin's death remains undocumented in digitally available Michigan death records.

Michigan Deaths and Burials 1800-1995 (collection 1675357), John Mogan/Magan, Wayne County, death 1900-1930. 6 results: John Magen (father of Hattie Megen); John Migan twice (German-origin Migan family); John Magan as father of Annie Magan (match score 0.001 — unrelated); two other low-confidence matches. No death record for John Mogan (I2, born ~1834 Ireland, Detroit resident) found. Detroit city death records since 1897 are at the Detroit Health Department and are not in FamilySearch collection 1675357. Michigan Death Certificates 1897-1952 at Michiganology.org (Michigan Archives, free online) remain unsearched and require an external search outside FamilySearch's holdings.

Read the 1870 census household at Greenfield, Wayne, Michigan. Persons enumerated in one dwelling (family structure inferred from surname, ages and listing order — not stated, as 1870 census has no relationship-to-head column): John Morgan, Male, born 1841, Ireland; Susan Morgan, Female, born 1845, New York; Edman Morgan, Male, born 1869, Michigan. Wife's given name is Susan (not Mary) and birthplace is New York — this is NOT the Mogan family (I2 John Mogan / I1 Mary E. McAndrew). This John Morgan of Greenfield Township is a different Irish immigrant. The Mogan family remains unlocated in the 1870 census; they may have resided in Detroit city proper or were not yet in Wayne County by 1870.
